evidence.fact: The 2009 Overture 10 minority-report concurrence list includes TE Michael McLaughlin of Southwest Presbytery.
City Presbyterian Church of Albuquerque identifies Mike McLaughlin as its founding pastor, serving the Albuquerque church from its 2004 founding until he was called back to Missouri.
The tracked 2019 record identifies TE Mike McLaughlin in Missouri Presbytery.
Later tracked A Faithful PCA snapshots use the Mike McLaughlin name form.

reasoning_boundary: This is a reviewed identity equivalence for this one person, not a general rule that Mike and Michael name forms are interchangeable across the dataset. The 2009 Southwest Presbytery record aligns with the first-party Albuquerque church history, and that history explicitly connects Mike McLaughlin's New Mexico ministry to a later move back to Missouri, matching the later tracked PCA records.
